notes.title: THE TRIALS UPDATE
notes.content:
Are you ready for some TRIALS???

I bet you aren't....



In this update, you'll be, ahem, "TRIALLED" with new starting scenarios that provide EPIC gameplay.

4 New Starting item scenarios:

3-ball: Race against time, reach the other side of the map before the bomb goes off

Aether-ball: Floating items only!

Negative-One-Ball: Start with $750, money cannot go up!

Eden ball: Less rounds per level... but start with a selection of items

3 New Curses

Visual update for stone-slots

New items and balancing of existing items

Made it so beating a level on HARD unlocks easier difficulties too



Thanks for sticking with me throughout development o7.

I think the game is at a point where it's ready to be lifted out of EA. I won't stop updating the game, but I think it's ready for full release.



Again, if you encounter any bugs/suggestions/ideas, please don't hesitate to join le discord.

notes.title: THE DOOMED UPDATE
notes.content:
In this update, I added a bunch more DOOMED items that synergize with existing stuff.

Includes doomed-sword, doomed-scythe, doomed-shield, helmet, and crossbow.



I also added a few other changes here and there:

- Fixed a bunch of bugs

- Clarified some unclear descriptions

- Made early-game less punishing for noobs by removing negative-bonus items



Happy gamin, folks ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: THE MARBLE UPDATE
notes.content:
- Added new trigger: "Buffed".

- Added a bunch of new items.

- A lot of bug fixes and small QoL tweaks.



Urn items: Activate when an item is buffed.

This has many many use-cases, and can help with your economy early.

Log / Sword hilt: Buffs sword/axe items.

Mini-shield: A friendlier replacement to the early-game wooden-shield.

notes.title: HUUGE UDPATE (v1.2)
notes.content:
THE GUARDIANS AND CURSES UPDATE
Hoo boy, this was a BIG BIG update.

Daily runs were added, alongside a TONNE of new content, features, cosmetics, and systems.


Biggest features:
Created randomized daily-runs

Added new Curses system

Added over 30 new items

Added 6 new slots

Added new music

Alongside a plethora of other improvements and fixes.
